Token methodology

The stacked bar uses usage_log.input_tokens (excludes cache) with cache = cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens. Bar height is their per-day total; hover or tap a bar for the split.

Output is on its own axis because it’s ~30× smaller.

The model split shows each day’s tokens across the top 5 models by volume, with the rest folded into “Other.”

Pricing Discounts

X = realized discount vs direct provider price, binned in 5% buckets. Last full UTC days.

Discount methodology

Realized discount = 1 - buyer_cost_usdc / direct_cost_usdc.

The distribution uses the last 7 full UTC days and includes paid non-fallback rows where direct and buyer costs are both greater than zero.

Median is reported as the lower edge of the median 5% bucket to keep high-volume windows fast and stable.
